lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern across the central and posterior flank, with increased density visible toward the anterior frame edge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating visible rectangular grid anchor nodes across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by sharp vertical luminance gradients with light-colored dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse and irregularly distributed high-luminance blobs located within the remaining silhouette of the primary dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural truncation and irregular margins of the first dorsal fin apex and posterior edge; a dark, elongated biological attachment is visible at the anterior base of the fin, and a thin, trailing filamentous object extends from the superior damaged edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, high-chroma yellow-and-black vertically banded organism in the lower central field of view proximal to the shark's ventral surface.
